about_the_game:
The Ember Guardian : First Flames is the demo of the full game, The Ember Guardian.

This demo includes an introductory level and a replayable level. Between each defeat you can upgrade your character and camp at the HUB, making this demo a roguelike experience.

The darkness is relentless. The Fire is your only hope. Protect it… or be consumed.

You are a Guardian, a lone wanderer carrying the last embers of a dying world. With only your wits, your weapons, and your loyal hound by your side, you must push back the horrors that lurk within the darkness.

Venture into the unknown and scavenge forgotten lands for resources. Every expedition demands careful preparation — weapon selection and ammunition supplies play a crucial role in determining whether you'll succeed or fail... Above all, time is your most precious resource. Make sure to return to camp before nightfall, or risk having to rebuild the ashes that are left.

Your camp is your last line of defense. Craft ammunition, expand your camp to strengthen your defenses and manage your workers carefully.

When night falls, they come. Hordes of relentless creatures, drawn to the light of your fire, rushing in from all sides. Armed with an arsenal of unique weapons, you must hold the line. Modify your guns, unlock perks, unleash devastating abilities, because if the fire dies… so do you.

Each battle is a lesson, each defeat a step forward. Return to your hub between each attempt where you can permanently unlock new weapons, skills and upgrade structures !

The flame is more than fire—it’s hope, strength, and survival itself. Protect it with everything you have and defy the darkness that seeks to consume it.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: 2 Ghz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Graphics card with shader model 4.0+
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Explore a post-apocaliptic world in a beautiful pixel art style. Recruit and command workers to gather resources, build your camp and setup your defenses during the day. At night, fend off waves of deadly creatures with powerful, upgradable weapons.
